key_insights: Trading altcoins is essentially expressing a leveraged view on Bitcoin direction and volatility
Strong coins tend to continue being strong; avoid longing lagards
Bitcoin consolidation after an uptrend is favorable for altcoin rotation
Correlation trap: multiple altcoin positions at 2% risk each equals 10% correlated risk
Sectoral hedging doesn't work well in altcoins due to high correlation
Invisible altcoin resistance often comes from BTC/ETH levels
Market beta effect: when BTC is up X%, altcoins typically up more than X%, and vice versa
summary: This episode introduces Altcoin Thursday, focusing on an altcoin trading framework and technical analysis of specific coins. Cred explains that altcoins express leveraged views on Bitcoin and identifies favorable conditions for altcoin performance. Several bullish setups were discussed including SOL reclaiming $24, BNB at $328, and LTC breaking above $100. The emphasis was on trading strong coins with good technical structure rather than catching up plays.
